checks: HMLR_PG1_SCOPE
Practice Guide 1 covers first registration of unregistered freehold and leasehold estates in land.
HMLR_PG1_LEGAL_ESTATES
The guide states that legal estates capable of registration include a fee simple absolute in possession and a term of years absolute.
HMLR_PG1_EXCLUSIONS
The guide treats adverse-possession applications and new leases out of registered titles under separate registration routes.
HMLR_PG2_ORIGINAL_DEEDS
For unregistered property, proof of title is normally evidenced by control of the original title deeds.
HMLR_PG2_EVENT_ACCOUNT
A lost-or-destroyed deeds application must explain the events that caused the loss or destruction.
HMLR_PG2_POSSESSORY_RISK
HM Land Registry may grant only possessory title where the evidence does not establish the loss events and title history beyond doubt.
HMLR_PG4_REGISTERED_SCOPE
Practice Guide 4 covers adverse-possession applications affecting registered land.
HMLR_PG4_NOTICE_PROCESS
The guide covers HM Land Registry notice procedures and the options available to recipients of an application notice.
HMLR_PG4_SCHEDULE6_ROUTE
The guide sets out the Schedule 6 process, including counter-notice conditions and possible later applications.
HMLR_PG5_UNREGISTERED_SCOPE
Practice Guide 5 covers unregistered land and registered land where the right arose before 13 October 2003.
HMLR_PG5_TITLE_EFFECT
For unregistered land, adverse possession can combine possession-based title with extinction of the documentary title under the Limitation Act 1980.
HMLR_PG5_APPLICATION_OBJECTION
The guide covers registration applications, HM Land Registry response, notice and objection procedures.
PL_HS2_DESCRIPTION
The consideration describes land protected because it may be needed to build the HS2 railway.
PL_HS2_TAGS
It is tagged as a local-plan constraint, safeguarded land and policies-map consideration.
PL_HS2_LEGISLATION_STAGE
The page cites the High Speed Rail (London–West Midlands) Act 2017 and records the design stage as Backlog.
PL_AERO_DESCRIPTION
The consideration covers areas safeguarded for aerodromes, technical sites and military explosives storage.
PL_AERO_TAGS
It is tagged as a local-plan safeguarded-land constraint.
PL_AERO_RELATED_DATASETS
The page lists safeguarded military explosives site and safeguarded aerodrome as related datasets.
PL_ROADWORKS_DESCRIPTION
The consideration describes land reserved for roadworks.
PL_ROADWORKS_TAGS
It is tagged as a constraint and safeguarded-land consideration.
PL_ROADWORKS_LEGISLATION
The page cites the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
PL_MINERALS_DESCRIPTION
The consideration covers locations for future mineral extraction such as sand, gravel and crushed-rock sites.
PL_MINERALS_TAGS
It is tagged as a local-plan constraint and safeguarded-land consideration.
PL_MINERALS_STAGE
The page records the design stage as Research and notes that mineral and waste local-plan mapping can be difficult to collect consistently.
EA_FZDSM1_COVERAGE
The first-return DSM is a 1m raster elevation model covering approximately 99 percent of England.
EA_FZDSM1_SOURCE
It is derived from National LIDAR Programme surveys captured between November 2016 and May 2022 and merged with feathering at survey overlaps.
EA_FZDSM1_SUPPLY_ACCURACY
It is supplied in 5km GeoTIFF tiles aligned to the OS National Grid, referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn with OSTN15, with contributing survey accuracy of plus or minus 15cm RMSE.
EA_POINT_CLOUD_CONTENT
The archive contains highly accurate three-dimensional x, y and z LIDAR points with component attributes.
EA_POINT_CLOUD_DERIVATION
Environment Agency time-stamped DSM and DTM raster products are derived from point-cloud data.
EA_POINT_CLOUD_ARCHIVE_CAVEAT
Point clouds are available for surveys back to 2006, but a matching point cloud is not guaranteed for every historic surface model because of archival practices.
OS_T50_GPKG_NATIONAL_FILE
OS Terrain 50 contours are supplied as a single national GeoPackage file.
OS_T50_GPKG_LAYERS
The GeoPackage contains spot_height, land_water_boundary and contour_line layers.
OS_T50_GPKG_ATTRIBUTES
The GeoPackage uses user-friendly attribute names and supports large, standards-based vector data in one file.
OS_T50_MBTILES_NATIONAL
OS Terrain 50 contour layers are supplied nationally in a single MBTiles vector-tile file.
OS_T50_MBTILES_CRS
The vector tiles are supplied in Web Mercator projection, EPSG:3857.
OS_T50_MBTILES_ZOOMS
Contour, spot-height and land-water-boundary attributes are mapped from zoom level 9 through 14 and not mapped at zoom levels 0 through 8.
